segments.t: Andrea Martel wakes up late in her apartment and discovers that her star client Jose Garcia is missing. When the film crew arrives to pick him up, Andrea runs to check on baby Flora only to find her crib completely empty. Let's listen to her morning panic in French first.
Mince! Quelle heure est-il?
José? Il faut te lever maintenant!
Dépêche-toi, on est en retard.
José, où es-tu passé?
Allô Andréa? Je viens chercher José.
Écoute, je le cherche aussi.
Il n'est pas avec toi?
Non, il n'est plus là!
La production attend sur le plateau.
Je te rappelle tout de suite.
Mon cœur, il faut te réveiller.
On est en retard pour la crèche.
Flora? Où est mon bébé?
Non, ce n'est pas possible!
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
Mince! Quelle heure est-il?
'Darn! What time is it?' Andrea realizes that her alarm failed to ring.
José? Il faut te lever maintenant!
'Jose? You have to get up now!' Andrea calls out into the apartment to wake her client.
Dépêche-toi, on est en retard.
'Hurry up, we are late.' Andrea stresses the urgent schedule for the film set.
José, où es-tu passé?
'Jose, where did you go?' Andrea searches through the rooms and finds the couch empty.
Allô Andréa? Je viens chercher José.
'Hello Andrea? I am coming to pick up Jose.' The production driver rings the doorbell from the street.
Écoute, je le cherche aussi.
'Listen, I am looking for him too.' Andrea confesses that her guest has vanished.
Il n'est pas avec toi?
'He is not with you?' The driver is astonished that the actor is missing.
Non, il n'est plus là!
'No, he is no longer here!' Andrea confirms that Jose disappeared without a word.
La production attend sur le plateau.
'Production is waiting on set.' The driver warns that the filming crew cannot afford delays.
Je te rappelle tout de suite.
'I call you back immediately.' Andrea ends the phone call to investigate the apartment.
Mon cœur, il faut te réveiller.
'Sweetheart, you must wake up.' Andrea enters the nursery to get her baby daughter ready.
On est en retard pour la crèche.
'We are late for the daycare.' Andrea rushes over to the small bed.
Flora? Où est mon bébé?
'Flora? Where is my baby?' Andrea stares at the unoccupied sheets in disbelief.
Non, ce n'est pas possible!
'No, this is not possible!' Andrea panics when she realizes that both Jose and Flora are gone. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.

Andrea discovers that both her movie star client and her infant daughter have vanished from the apartment. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'hour' and 'is it'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
Au revoir!
